_comment: Hand-curated sources. 'approved' records the product owner's licensing decision for the interim catalog (scripts/catalog/build_catalog.py publishes only approved youtube/link entries). HLS streams are never published from here: they need the Media3 playback validator first. All entries are also seeded into the database as DISCOVERED/UNREVIEWED.
